title: Annoying
subtitle: 令人煩厭，究竟是哪一種「煩」？
description: 令人煩厭，究竟是哪一種「煩」？

words.meaning: 令人惱怒的；令人煩躁的
words.note: 最接近 annoying 的常見說法，表示某人或某事使人不耐煩或惱怒。
words.example: The constant buzzing noise is extremely irritating.
words.exampleZh: 持續的嗡嗡聲非常令人煩躁。

options.explanation: boring = 無聊的，表示缺乏趣味，不一定令人惱怒。
difficult = 困難的，表示不容易完成，不等於煩人。
rude = 無禮的，表示缺乏禮貌，不等於造成煩躁。
irritating = 最接近 annoying 的常見說法，表示某人或某事使人不耐煩或惱怒。
loud = 大聲的，只描述音量，不一定令人煩。
stressful = 有壓力的，重點是造成壓力，不完全等於令人惱怒。

falseSynonyms.zh: 無聊不等於煩人 boring 表示不能引起興趣；annoying 表示使人煩躁或惱怒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The lecture was boring. The constant interruptions were annoying.

falseSynonyms.zh: 困難不等於煩人 difficult 表示不容易完成；困難的事不一定令人惱怒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The puzzle is difficult. The repeated error messages are irritating.

falseSynonyms.zh: 無禮不等於煩人 rude 表示缺乏禮貌；它可能令人煩，但核心意思不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His comment was rude. His constant interruptions were annoying.

falseSynonyms.zh: 大聲不等於煩人 loud 只表示聲音大；大聲未必一定令人煩。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The music was loud. The repeated alarm was irritating.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有壓力不等於煩人 stressful 表示造成壓力；annoying 更偏向造成惱怒或不耐煩。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Moving house can be stressful. A dripping tap can be annoying.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不愉快不等於煩人 unpleasant 範圍較廣，不一定特指惱怒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The smell was unpleasant. The repeated notifications were bothersome.

falseSynonyms.zh: 感到煩惱不等於令人煩惱 annoyed 形容人的感受；annoying 形容造成煩惱的人或事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I am annoyed. The noise is annoying.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與形容詞不同 irritation 是名詞；irritating 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The delay caused irritation. The delay was irritating.
